header.name: Piotr Falkowski
header.title: Senior Backend Software Developer with over 10 years of experience.

about.firstParagraph: Driven, passionate, problem solver. I taught myself C++ to analyze financial time series using ML. Then it snowballed into .NET and countless other technologies. I’ve seen a lot, maybe even too much sometimes. I drew conclusions and now I focus on clarity, maintainability and impact.
about.secondParagraph: Beyond my full-time work I develop the stock market analysis tool [Stock-Today](https://stock-today.com), I am CTO of [Squizzu](https://squizzu.com), I maintain several open source libraries and I write [False Green](https://falsegreen.dev), a blog about verification that looked green and wasn't.

consent: I hereby agree for processing the following personal information for the purposes of recruitment processes only.

igexao.title: IGE+XAO - Intern
igexao.description: Implemented database wide undo T-SQL procedure ahead of schedule using c# code generator based on table schema. Maintained C++ CAD desktop app.

transactor.title: Transactor Poland - Junior Software Developer
transactor.description: Started as a Junior Software Developer and was promoted to Regular after successfully delivering the first project — a WPF business intelligence application that aggregated data from multiple APIs, providing significant value to the customer at a low cost. C#, WPF, XSLT, XSD, SQLite, Ms SQL. Developed, refactored, bug fixed, and unit tested an end-to-end insurance lifetime management system. Participated in multiple third-party integrations, including payment providers and data enrichment services, ensuring interoperability between systems. T-SQL, WCF, ASP.NET API, WPF, Windows Forms, VB.NET, MS SQL, WWF, SignalR, SOAP, AzureDevops (VSTS at the time), Trello, Jira and Zendesk.

opengi.title: Open GI - Software Developer
opengi.description: Took part in modernizing legacy desktop monolith by splitting and migrating logic into microservices while heavily unit-testing existing functionality and moving slowly by first hosting the old Windows Application over Azure Virtual Desktop. Used ASP.NET Core, WCF, RabbitMQ, WWF, Azure IaaS, MongoDB, MS SQL, SonarQube, Docker.

ju.title: Jagiellonian University - Researcher
ju.description: I developed electroencephalogram (EEG) monkey brain activity classifier and an Arduino-based tactile stimulator. The stimulator features 2 gloves with 5 efectors, each controllable separately via COM and  [source](https://github.com/PFalkowski/HapticStimulatorPCA9685). For classification I used Python's Keras achieving accuracy above 0.8 after applying FFT and other transformations to raw EEG time series [source](https://github.com/PFalkowski/KerasClassifierEeg).

smh.title: Seville More Helory Polska - Senior Software Developer
smh.description: Implemented, documented and unit tested GIT inspired document version control in C# ASP.NET / CosmosDb / Azure AI (Cognitive) Search + Azure Service Bus + Redis + SignalR + SonarCloud. Cut Azure Redis Cache costs by implementing an intermediate cache layer based on CosmosDb. Designed and implemented the backend for a bespoke legal Q&A, FAQ, provisions, rights and clauses lifecycle management process that secured a key client, increasing company revenue by over 10%. C# Web.API + CosmosDb + React + Service Bus.

happyteam.title: Happy Team - Senior Software Developer
happyteam.description: Built the backend for a .NET MAUI mobile app from the ground up: a serverless API in Azure Functions talking to CosmosDb, a proxy service, and the whole supporting infrastructure described in Terraform. Designed for testability, ease of maintenance, performance and scalability.

stonex.title: StoneX Financial Services - Senior Software Developer
stonex.description: Migrating legacy client-facing cloud applications to a modular monolith in Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture. Removed the code review bottleneck in the team's SDLC and optimized DataGrid search by 10x. AI-first development with the emphasis on end-to-end and integration tests.

additionalInfo.hobbies: Hobbies: economics (personal finance and quantitative analysis), board games, squash, running, bodybuilding.

otherProjects.stockinsight: Stock market quant and fundamental analysis tool [Stock-Today](https://stock-today.com), giving daily updated insights for both speculative trading and long-term investing. Hosting: Azure, BE: C# MsSQL ML.NET, FE: pure HTML + CSS + JS.
otherProjects.squizzu: I am CTO of [Squizzu](https://squizzu.com), a tech quiz platform built with React and C# leveraging generative AI. I architected and implemented most of the data model, set up CosmosDB and KeyVault integrations and I own the Azure OpenAI integration.
otherProjects.falsegreen: I write and publish [False Green](https://falsegreen.dev), a blog about verification that looked green and wasn't — each post is a real incident where a check passed while the system stayed broken. Astro static site, deployed to Azure Static Web Apps by GitHub Actions over Terraform-managed infrastructure.
otherProjects.skills: I maintain a public set of [Claude Code skills](https://github.com/PFalkowski/skills) — over 30 repeatable workflows for code review, triage, handoff and release hygiene, installable as a Claude Code plugin.
otherProjects.otherVentures: Throughout my journey, I have also explored other startup ventures like an online course platform, and a calendar tool built with PowerApps. While these projects didn't achieve long-term success, they provided valuable lessons and skills like proficiency in PowerPlatform.
